youtube.description:
Sing B-I-N-G-O with Robo, Pip and Bingo the puppy, and learn the letters B, I, N, G and O! Five wooden letter blocks stand on the farm. In every new verse one letter hides and we clap instead: which letter is hiding? Three, two, one! Spell Bingo together, clap one, two, three, four, five times, bring the letters back and point to G.

What your child learns: the capital letters B, I, N, G and O, spelling a name letter by letter, and keeping a steady beat by clapping in place of a letter (one more clap each verse).

Sing at home: sing the letters slowly and hold up a finger for each one. In each new verse, clap instead of the first letter, then the first two, and so on, until the last verse is all claps. Ask "Which letter is hiding?" before you start the next verse. B-I-N-G-O is a traditional public-domain song with its traditional tune; the story, the letter blocks game and the spoken lines are original, written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.
